subject: reasoning
question: Shyam starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Shyam starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 12 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7ff354b5453da801b7521e58dd68f93718d3e61d4003cc3291205a94bff365c.png] 

Thus, Shyam should drive 5 km (10 km - 5 km) in the south direction in order to reach point A again.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
